title: ExerciseWorksheet has same flex-row-reverse RTL issue
body: The file src/ui/web/exerciserenderer/ExerciseWorksheet/index.tsx line 303 has the same pattern that was just fixed in QuestionCard: 'justify-end text-right flex-row-reverse gap-content-gap-xs'. The same fix (remove flex-row-reverse, change justify-end to justify-start) should be applied.
rationale: ExerciseWorksheet uses the same component pattern and will have the same RTL label alignment bug in Hebrew.
